components.name: Ink toggle
components.description: An on/off preference, with text for loading and unavailable states.
components.css: .ds-ink { font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 550; color: var(--color-control-text, #4d5966); background: var(--color-control, #eceff2); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: .4rem .75rem; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-ink:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-control-hover, #e1e7ec); } .ds-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3e596c); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-ink:disabled { background: transparent; cursor: default; }

components.name: Project card
components.description: Opaque content above the ink. The card itself is not a link.
components.html:
Social Time Tracker

An offline-first time tracker for iOS, with Live Activities and Dynamic Island integration.

Project notes

narrative.northStar: An empty canvas and an ink waterbrush
narrative.overview:
Galileo supplied the canvas metaphor, white/grey ground, and requirement for the cursor effect to remain behind the content. The implementation uses graphite text, white project cards, and space between groups. Visitors make the ink move; the text stays still.

Manrope gives the résumé content a conversational voice through open letterforms and moderate weights. The interaction supplies the expression that would otherwise come from imagery. There are no invented portraits or project screenshots.
keyCharacteristics: White/grey ground with opaque content cards.
Left-aligned type and a narrow reading column.
Motion limited to the visitor's ink trail and control-state transitions.
Keyline stroke icons and fine ink edges, with calm motion.
dos: Do keep text and white cards more prominent than the ink.
Do preserve normal cursor behavior, keyboard operation, and touch scrolling.
Do test supporting text against the darkest ink, not just the blank canvas.
Do use the existing type scale and let content determine height.
donts: Don't add a dark theme in conflict with the owner's white/grey brief.
Don't make the background an autonomous animation or hide text behind an entrance effect.
Don't add fabricated project imagery or nonfunctional project links.
